note: Mixed sets (2 bass-register instruments plus continuo: Bertali a 4 and a 6 with gamba+violone, Capricornus a 8, Bach BWV 1051, Buxtehude BuxWV 267) are decided on the gamba/concertante voice; the violone or cello there shares the bass with the continuo. Weakest calls (fold for lack of evidence): Albrici a 5, Duben Sinfonia a 4, Falconieri Libro I, Corelli WoO 8; weakest own-line calls: Buchner, Buonamente (the lines were not compared with the continuo, the part layout and a-N titles decide).
